windowsAgents.claudeNotFoundHint: The `claude` CLI cannot be found. Install it (`irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex` in PowerShell, or `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`), or check that it is in %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin or %APPDATA%\npm.
windowsAgents.bridgeUnavailableDetail: Agents' permission requests and questions will not reach the interface. Install Node (`winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS`) to get them back; agents still run, according to their mode.
windowsAgents.ffmpegHint: The QA screenshots are kept, but no video is assembled from them. Install ffmpeg (`winget install Gyan.FFmpeg`) to get it back under the findings.
windowsAgents.nodeMissing: Node cannot be found on this machine: the mission tools go through an MCP bridge that it runs. Install Node (`winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS`), then relaunch the mission. Ordinary agents keep working.
